resolved_questions.was_666_on_or_in_forehead: Neither preposition is present in the recovered May 11 wording. Tim said: 'when they are this, then their forehead is this number.' Therefore archive paraphrase should be 'forehead is this number', not '666 in forehead' or '666 on forehead', unless another primary turn is recovered.
resolved_questions.was_cube_inside_forehead: No recovered primary wording says a physical cube is inside or on the forehead. The recovered sequence is cube-state/geometry/compression → seed contained/framed/made smaller → forehead 'is this number'.
resolved_questions.forehead_eye_pineal: No direct Eye or pineal link is recovered in the May 11 primary wording. Any Eye/pineal relation remains a later cross-system comparison unless another source is found.
resolved_questions.forehead_mind_identity: Identity/state is strongly implied by 'when they are this'; mind remains interpretive. Revelation provides an external allegiance/identity comparator, not proof of Tim's intended anatomy.
resolved_questions.forehead_mark_seal: The May 11 Tim wording does not explicitly say mark or seal. Mark/seal enters through later Revelation comparison.
resolved_questions.forehead_moon_saturn: The May 11 wording directly establishes cube/666/forehead but the currently recovered excerpt does not explicitly name Moon or Saturn. Saturn/Moon become explicit in adjacent April precursor and August mature layers.
resolved_questions.forehead_contract: Not explicit in May 11; contract appears strongly in August 10 Saturnian-Cube/Farm material.
resolved_questions.cube_is_666_or_represents: Resolved: on May 11 Tim says '666 is the cube itself'. Later Saturnian Cube can therefore be treated as an application of a prior Cube=666 equation, not the origin of the equation.
resolved_questions.cube_number_of_beast: Tim's 2026-09-09 remembered formulation and August 10 mature cluster call the Saturnian cube/666 the Number-of-the-Beast system. Biblical Revelation calls 666 the beast's number; it does not call a cube the beast's number.
